description: This is a Java source file defining the MainViewModel class for the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It manages application state, data synchronization, navigation, and interactions with the repository and external services.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the main application state, data synchronization, navigation, and user interactions for the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: restoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores saved state from SavedStateHandle, including current account, search term, selected category, and expanded category.

methods.name: getCurrentAccount
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the current account, with distinct changes only.

methods.name: postCurrentAccount
methods.description: Sets the current account, updates branding, and resets navigation if account changes.

methods.name: getSearchTerm
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the current search term.

methods.name: postSearchTerm
methods.description: Updates the search term in state and LiveData.

methods.name: getSelectedCategory
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the selected navigation category.

methods.name: postSelectedCategory
methods.description: Sets the selected category and manages expanded categories accordingly.

methods.name: getCategorySortingMethodOfSelectedCategory
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the sorting method for the selected category.

methods.name: modifyCategoryOrder
methods.description: Modifies the sorting order of a category.

methods.name: postExpandedCategory
methods.description: Sets the expanded category state.

methods.name: getExpandedCategory
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the expanded category.

methods.name: getNotesListLiveData
methods.description: Provides LiveData of the list of notes/items based on current filters and sorting.

methods.name: fromNotes
methods.description: Converts a list of notes into display items based on sorting and category.

methods.name: getNavigationCategories
methods.description: Provides LiveData of navigation categories with counts.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount
methods.description: Creates navigation items from categories with note counts, handling hierarchy and expansion.

methods.name: synchronizeCapabilitiesAndNotes
methods.description: Synchronizes capabilities and notes for a given account.

methods.name: synchronizeCapabilities
methods.description: Updates capabilities of an account, including ETag, color, API version, and direct editing availability.

methods.name: synchronizeNotes
methods.description: Syncs notes for an account, scheduling background sync and updating capabilities.

methods.name: getSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns LiveData indicating sync status.

methods.name: getSyncErrors
methods.description: Returns LiveData of sync errors.

methods.name: hasMultipleAccountsConfigured
methods.description: Indicates if multiple accounts are configured.

methods.name: getLocalAccountByAccountName
methods.description: Retrieves a local account by its name.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns list of all accounts.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets category for a list of notes.

methods.name: moveNoteToAnotherAccount
methods.description: Moves a note to another account.

methods.name: toggleFavoriteAndSync
methods.description: Toggles favorite status of a note and syncs.

methods.name: deleteNoteAndSync
methods.description: Deletes a note and syncs.

methods.name: deleteNotesAndSync
methods.description: Deletes multiple notes and syncs.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Adds a new account with capabilities.

methods.name: getFullNote$
methods.description: Retrieves a full note as LiveData by ID.

methods.name: getFullNote
methods.description: Retrieves a full note by ID.

methods.name: getFullNotesWithCategory
methods.description: Retrieves multiple notes with categories as LiveData.

methods.name: addNoteAndSync
methods.description: Adds a note and syncs.

methods.name: updateNoteAndSync
methods.description: Updates a note and syncs.

methods.name: createOrUpdateSingleNoteWidgetData
methods.description: Creates or updates widget data for a note.

methods.name: getLocalModifiedNotes
methods.description: Retrieves locally modified notes for an account.

methods.name: getAccountsCount
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the number of accounts.

methods.name: collectNoteContents
methods.description: Concatenates contents of multiple notes into a single string.

methods.name: containsNonInfrastructureRelatedItems
methods.description: Checks if exceptions contain non-infrastructure errors.

methods.name: exceptionIsInfrastructureRelated
methods.description: Determines if an exception is related to infrastructure issues.

methods.name: isSoftwareCausedConnectionAbort
methods.description: Checks if message indicates a software connection abort.

methods.name: isNetworkUnreachable
methods.description: Checks if message indicates network unreachable error.
